mcpKeys.title: MCP Keys
mcpKeys.description: API keys that let external clients (e.g. an MCP or AI agent) access CyberSheppard over POST /api/mcp. A key impersonates your user, so your role's permissions apply. Write-scope keys can run write tools and can only be created by an administrator.
